content:
Overview

Ryazan is a city in Ryazan Oblast with a population of 540,000. A historic city southeast of Moscow, known for its magnificent Kremlin, the Ryazan Museum of Long-Range Aviation, and traditional crafts. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
